Merge pull request #4 from tahseenx-alt/claude/landing-page-czvifi

Add repository analytics: languages, activity, contributors, commits

Add repository analytics: languages, activity, contributors, commits

After a successful search, four dashboard cards appear under the
overview card. Languages, commits and contributors each take one
request; the commits request feeds both the weekly activity chart and
the recent commits list. Responses are cached so repeat searches make
no new requests. Each card has its own loading and error state, and
the Recharts chart is lazy-loaded to keep the first page load small.

Merge pull request #3 from tahseenx-alt/claude/landing-page-czvifi

Connect the repository search to the GitHub API

Connect the repository search to the GitHub REST API

The search form now accepts owner/repo or a GitHub URL, fetches the
repository with fetch(), and shows its name, description, stars, forks,
open issues, language and last updated date. Adds a loading state and
clear messages for invalid input, missing repositories, network errors
and GitHub rate limits.
